external_sources.title: Feature Selection with the Boruta Package
external_sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and bibliography, lines 13–35; no PDF/full-paper reading claimed.
external_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Boruta wraps Random-Forest classification and compares feature relevance with random probes. This motivates a sentinel comparator, without establishing validity for this temporal ranking selector.

external_sources.title: Authors' Model-X methodology: Modeling and Outline
external_sources.read_scope: Both full short pages returned; relied only on Modeling 9–18 and Outline 10–27. Fixed-X/paper bodies not relied upon.
external_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Model-X assumes iid rows and a known feature distribution, with swap-invariant knockoffs conditionally independent of responses given original features. Feature importance must be fair under swapping. These assumptions and FDR control do not automatically transfer to exogenous independent noise and temporal dependent ranking rows.
